edits.old: Then the grant refuses it, the boundary test fails the build, and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses it, the boundary test fails the build, and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC10 Error answers of the provided operations (401, 403, 404)
    Given the caller is not authenticated, lacks access, or names a case or placement that does not exist
    When the provided operation is called
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 with the platform error envelope and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC11 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (exception X7)
    Given a write with an Idempotency-Key has already been applied
    When the same write is replayed with that Idempotency-Key
    Then no second replacement is created and the replay answers the record that exists

  Scenario: AC12 Activity retried or timed out
    Given the recordPlacementOverride activity is retried or times out
    When the workflow runs the step again
    Then only one replacement exists and nothing is recorded twice

  Scenario: AC13 Consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given a consumed contract call fails or does not answer
    When the action is taken
    Then nothing is written and the caller is not answered with a success

  Scenario: AC14 Status change not allowed by the model
    Given the requested status change is not allowed by the instruction status model
    When the action is taken
    Then the request is refused and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC15 Partner-portal right C not held (exception X2)
    Given the user holds partner-portal right U and not right C
    When the action is taken
    Then the request is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002 before any read or write, and no record is written

  Scenario: AC16 Panel status not the one the rule requires (exception X4)
    Given the chosen partner is on the panel with a panel status other than the one the rule requires
    When the action is taken
    Then the request is refused with 422 and MSG-GEN-001, and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC17 Rule-row read does not answer or breaker open (exception X5)
    Given the rwb-decision rule-row read does not answer within 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the action is taken
    Then the step retries on the workflow's own schedule, nothing is written, and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC18 Reason absent (exception X6)
    Given the reason is absent
    When the action is taken
    Then the request is refused with 422 and MSG-GEN-001, and nothing is written
